CustomField.description: True when today is between Start Date and End Date (inclusive) and Date Access Removed is blank. False when today is outside Start Date and End Date, either date is blank, or Date Access Removed is populated.
CustomField.formula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(End_Date__c)), TODAY() >= Start_Date__c, TODAY() <= End_Date__c, ISBLANK(Date_Access_Removed__c) )
CustomField.label: Active
